I'm an emeritus professor at the College of the Holy Cross.  On this site, I'm presenting my current digital scholarly work.



- links to [projects I'm currently working on](./projects/index.qmd)
- notes and comments about my work in [blog posts](./posts.qmd)

::: {.callout-note}
The blog posts include a handful of notes from a personal site I was maintaining at [https://neelsmith.quarto.pub](https://neelsmith.quarto.pub), until quarto.pub stopped publishing new material. I've copied material from the quarto site about my work in Julia from 2020-2024 to a frozen site at [https://neelsmith.github.io/juliawork/](https://neelsmith.github.io/juliawork).
:::
